safety.h2: Built so a mistake is never the end of a file
safety.sub: AI makes mistakes. Desktop Steward is designed so that none of them is permanent, and the dangerous ones never happen without you.
cards: Rules in plain words
You choose which folders Claude may read and which it may change. Everything else does not exist for it.
Asks before anything risky
Deleting, replacing a file or moving many files opens a confirmation window on your computer. Claude cannot click it for you.
Undo for 7 days
The old version is kept before a change. Deleted files wait in a holding area. Say “undo” and it is back.
Off limits, always
Passwords, keys, browser data, mail, system folders, and anything that runs when double-clicked. No terminal, no network.
A panel of everything it did
Say “open the panel” to see every change with an Undo button, the activity log, and the rules in force. Only reachable from your computer.
safety.note: Read the full security model, including what it does not protect against.

Can Claude delete my files by mistake?
Every deletion opens a confirmation window on your computer that Claude cannot click. Deleted files are kept for 7 days and can be brought back with “undo”.
Why the red “not verified” banner on install?
Claude Desktop shows it for every extension that is not listed in Anthropic's directory. We are working on the listing.

Can I use it from my phone?
Yes. Say “turn on remote access” on the computer, add the connector in the Claude app on your phone and type the one-time code. Confirmations still happen on the computer. Step-by-step guide.

phone.title: Use Claude on your phone with the files on your computer
phone.desc: Step by step for non-technical people: turn on remote access in Desktop Steward, connect the Claude app on your iPhone or Android (or ChatGPT), and ask for files from anywhere. Confirmations stay on the computer.
phone.h1: Use Claude on your phone with the files on your computer
phone.lead: You are on the sofa, the laptop is in the other room. Here is how to ask Claude on your phone to find, sort or send a file that lives on the computer. No technical steps, about five minutes once.
need: A Mac or Windows computer with Claude Desktop and Desktop Steward installed. The computer must be on and Claude Desktop open while you use it from the phone.
The Claude app on your phone (iPhone or Android), or Claude in a browser, or ChatGPT.
phone.tip1: Remote access goes through the Desktop Steward relay, which only passes messages back and forth and stores nothing. It is part of Desktop Steward Pro ($10 a month, first 7 days free). The first 7 days are free on every computer.
phone.s1H2: Step 1 — on the computer: turn remote access on
s1: Open Claude Desktop and start a new chat.
Type: “Turn on remote access” (or “enable remote access”).
Claude answers with two things: an address that looks like https://relay.desktopsteward.com/mcp, and a one-time code of 8 digits, for example 4821 0375. The code works for 10 minutes and for one app.
s1chat:
Remote access is on. Connector address: https://relay.desktopsteward.com/mcp
One-time code: 4821 0375 (valid 10 minutes, one use). …
phone.s1note: Keep this chat open; you will type the code on the phone in a moment.
phone.s2H2: Step 2 — on the phone: add the connector
s2: Tap your profile picture or the menu, then Settings.
In the address field, type exactly https://relay.desktopsteward.com/mcp. Name it “My computer”. Leave the authentication fields empty. Tap Add.
The phone opens a sign-in page titled “Connect Claude to your computer”. Type the 8 digits from Step 1 and tap Connect.
You are back in the Claude app. The connector shows as connected.
phone.s2web: Claude in a browser (claude.ai): the same path, Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
phone.s2gpt: ChatGPT (Plus, Pro or Business): Settings → Connectors → Create. Paste the same address as the MCP server, choose OAuth as authentication, save. When ChatGPT opens the sign-in page, type the code. If you do not see “Create”, turn on Developer mode in Settings → Connectors → Advanced.
s3chat: What is in my Downloads folder?
Claude on the phone lists the folder from the computer.
Find the invoice from March and read me the total.
Claude searches the computer, opens the PDF and answers.
phone.s3note: Everything works the same as on the computer: the same folders, the same rules, undo for every change.
phone.ok: Deleting, replacing or moving many files opens the confirmation window on the computer, not on the phone. If you are away from the computer, the phone waits up to a minute and then says the computer did not answer. That is on purpose: a lost phone cannot delete anything on your computer.
fix: “The computer is offline” — the computer is asleep or Claude Desktop is closed. Wake it up, open Claude Desktop, try again.
“That code did not work” — codes expire after 10 minutes and work once. On the computer say “show remote access code” for a new one.
The sign-in page never appears — check that the address was typed exactly, with /mcp at the end.
Another phone or ChatGPT too — each app needs its own code: “show remote access code”.
phone.off: On the computer say “Turn off remote access”. Every app that was connected is signed out at once. Say “turn on remote access” to start again; connected apps will need a new code.
phone.finalSub: Install Desktop Steward, say “turn on remote access”, and your phone can reach your files.

chatgpt.title: Use ChatGPT with the files on your computer — Desktop Steward
chatgpt.desc: A clear path for ChatGPT users: install Desktop Steward on the computer, connect ChatGPT with a one-time code, and ask for your files from any device. Confirmations stay on the computer, every change can be undone.
chatgpt.h1: Use ChatGPT with the files on your computer
chatgpt.lead: ChatGPT cannot see your disk on its own. Desktop Steward gives it careful hands: your folders, your rules, a confirmation window before anything risky, and undo. Here is the whole path, about ten minutes once.
need: A Mac or Windows computer that stays on while you use it.
A ChatGPT plan with connectors: Plus, Pro, Business or Enterprise. (Free cannot add custom connectors yet.)
The Desktop Steward app on the computer: a free download that runs on its own. No Claude account needed.
chatgpt.s1H2: Step 1 — install Desktop Steward on the computer
s1: Download the Desktop Steward app for Mac or Windows and open it. An icon appears in the menu bar or tray and the panel opens in your browser.
In the panel press Turn on and choose the ChatGPT tab.
You get an address (https://relay.desktopsteward.com/mcp) and a one-time code of 8 digits, valid 10 minutes.
s2: In ChatGPT open Settings → Connectors. If there is no Create button, open Advanced and turn on Developer mode.
Press Create. Name: “My computer”. MCP server URL: https://relay.desktopsteward.com/mcp. Authentication: OAuth. Save.
ChatGPT opens the Desktop Steward sign-in page. Type the 8 digits and press Connect.
Back in ChatGPT, start a chat, open the tools menu (the + or “…” next to the message box) and switch on “My computer”.
s3chat: What is in my Downloads folder?
ChatGPT lists the folder from the computer.
Combine the three scans from today into one PDF.
ChatGPT finds them, shows the page order, and creates the PDF in Documents/AI Workspace.
chatgpt.s3note: The same folders and rules as in Claude. Deleting, replacing or moving many files opens the confirmation window on the computer; ChatGPT waits for your answer.
chatgpt.whyH2: How it runs on the computer
chatgpt.why: The Desktop Steward app sits in the menu bar or tray, starts at login and keeps an outgoing connection to the Desktop Steward relay; ChatGPT reaches your computer through it. Nothing is opened on your network. If you also use Claude Desktop, the extension there shares the same folders, rules and history.
fix: No “Create” button — Developer mode is off (Settings → Connectors → Advanced), or the plan does not include connectors.
“The computer is offline” — the computer is asleep or the Desktop Steward app is closed. Open it and try again.
“That code did not work” — codes expire after 10 minutes and work once. On the computer, open the panel from the icon and press New code.
ChatGPT does not use the connector — switch it on for the chat in the tools menu, or ask explicitly: “use My computer to list my Downloads”.
chatgpt.pro: Remote access, which ChatGPT uses, is part of Desktop Steward Pro: $10 a month, first 7 days free on every computer, cancel any time. Using Desktop Steward inside Claude Desktop stays free.
chatgpt.finalSub: Install the app, press “Turn on”, connect ChatGPT with the code.
